tagline: Software built to solve real problems.
description: Generational Intelligence is an Irish software development company creating practical digital platforms that improve how businesses organise work, connect services and manage everyday operations.

projects.name: GatherWell
projects.description: GatherWell is an emerging marketplace and operations platform connecting workplaces with catering and service providers. It is being developed to simplify how businesses discover providers, coordinate requirements and manage workplace food and events.

projects.name: Angaro
projects.description: Angaro is a delivery operations platform being developed for small and growing fleets. It brings route planning, dispatch coordination, driver workflows and delivery visibility into one connected environment.
